title: vendor-src manifest
description: Configuration for vendor-src: vendored dependency sources under a directory such as repos/.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation.

repos.description: Vendored repositories keyed by directory name under dir.

package.description: npm package name this checkout corresponds to.

url.description: Git remote URL used for subtree add/pull.

version.description: Installed package version this checkout is pinned to.

ref.description: Git ref/tag that was vendored (often package@version).

ignore.description: Extra globs matched against paths relative to this vendored repo root (posix). Defaults always prune **/.DS_Store, **/repos/**, **/node_modules/**, and **/.git/**. A pattern ending in /** also matches the directory itself.
